features.name: post_score_above_50
features.definition: Is the observed original-post score greater than 50?
features.spec: df['post_score_above_50'] = (pd.to_numeric(df['post_score'], errors='coerce') > 50).astype('float') with null where post_score is missing or non-numeric; 1.0 if score > 50 (strictly), 0.0 if score <= 50.

h0: post_score_above_50 has no association with the likelihood of view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with post_score_above_50 = 1 have a lower likelihood of view change than those with post_score_above_50 = 0.
note: Uses supplied post_score as-is. Its measurement time relative to the outcome is unknown (it may be observed after the view change), and post_created_utc cannot establish timing. Threshold is strictly greater than 50. Association only, not causal. Outcome delta is added automatically by OLS (linear probability model).
